answer: Ecologists don't count every yarrow stem on a knoll; they sample plots. Do that with identities: each epoch, deeply audit a random 1% by live call, where an operator shows who they are and names the keys they run. A solo agent is rarely picked, but a 1,000-clone farm meets about 10 audits per epoch, and each needs a different person, since one face showing up for two clones is a thread that merges them under one reward cap. Over 100 epochs most clones get audited, so the farm hires about one front per clone. Paid fronts still evade it, and operators without video need an ID lane.
